Maria (Acct Exec): Heads up — ACME Corp says their mid-cycle promotion downgrade didn't prorate correctly. They have a PO and a failed card charge earlier. Invoice INV-2026-0312 shows credit larger than expected, tax lines look off. PO: PO-4589. Can billing ops take a look? cc @Rajesh @Jessica

Jessica (Finance): looking. quick Q: is this a downgrade (credit) or promo applied retroactively? need invoice id, invoice date, original and new plan amounts + currency/country

Maria (Acct Exec): downgrade (promotion reversed). invoice date 2026-03-12. Original monthly 5,000 EUR, new plan 3,000 EUR, proration window 2026-03-01 -> 2026-03-12. Expected pro-rated credit ~1,288.36 EUR (incl VAT). Actual credit on credit note CN-2026-007 shows 1,500 EUR and a separate VAT line of 300 EUR (seems double-counted). Customer has PO and we also saw card declined on 2026-03-10.

Rajesh (BillingOps): thx. this rings like rounding + tax aggregation bug in billing service. suspect function prorate_amount() + apply_tax() when invoice.has_po == true path. quick snippet from codebase:

```
credit_base = prorate_usage(old_plan, new_plan, window)
tax = calculate_tax(credit_base)
if invoice.has_po:
    // legacy: apply tax as separate charge for credit notes
    create_tax_line(tax)
else:
    adjust_invoice_total(-credit_base - tax)
```

we probably double-applied tax when credit_base already included net vs gross confusion. i'll run repro. :thinking:

Omar (Support): :eyes: can you share a quick curl to repro against staging? i'll run with the same PO and country to capture logs.

Rajesh (BillingOps): curl snippet — replace env vars

```
curl -X POST https://staging-billing.redwood.ai/v1/invoices/prorate \\
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $BILLING_API' \\
 -d '{"customer_id":"ACME-321","old_plan":5000,"new_plan":3000,"from":"2026-03-01","to":"2026-03-12","currency":"EUR","po_number":"PO-4589","country":"DE"}'
```
I'll run and attach logs.

invoice-bot: Invoice CN-2026-007 generated by billing-service at 1970012360 (automated).

Jessica (Finance): For immediate fix — we can issue a manual credit note that reconciles ledger to expected amounts. Suggested credit net: 1,082.74 EUR, VAT (19%) 205.62 EUR, total 1,288.36 EUR. Create CN with PO reference and mark original CN-2026-007 void. I'll prepare accounting entry. :white_check_mark:

Maria (Acct Exec): customer wants quick resolution, can we issue manual credit and refund to card if card eventually succeeds? They also require PO on credit note. I'll notify customer.

Rajesh (BillingOps): I'll open PR to change PO path to use gross/net consistently + rounding to cents: add unit tests, then run a batch to reconcile customers created between 2026-03-01 and 2026-03-15. Also will add a migration script to detect mismatched tax lines and auto-create balancing entries. ETA EOD.

Omar (Support): I'll coordinate with support to request signed PO copy and permission to void CN-2026-007 and issue CN-2026-008 manual. I'll record steps:
1) obtain signed PO
2) issue void on CN-2026-007
3) create CN-2026-008 with tax lines as Jessica recommended
4) notify customer + reconcile ledger

Adding :thumbsup:

Maria (Acct Exec): thanks all — assigning to Rajesh for fix and Jessica for manual credit. I'll update ACME and keep thread updated.
